attempts.why: Error text #f0a0a0 on white has ~1.8:1 contrast and is unreadable; use the defined error color var(--err) #b00020 for sufficient contrast without hiding content.

selfVerify.reason: Error text #err now rgb(176,0,32) = #b00020 (var(--err)) with sufficient contrast, visible 416x21 with text 'Enter a valid email address.' not display:none/hidden, no horizontal overflow (docScrollWidth 1200 == viewport 1200) and card/grid/hero/table layout intact at 1200x800.
